title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Elaina, a young witch inspired by childhood adventure books, travels without a destination, visiting one country after another and meeting good and bad people along the way. Volume 1 includes a novice witch seeking a mentor, a man-eating flower field, a town with fake currency, and Elaina's own backstory (Square Enix blurb via AniList/MU; Anime UK News review).
life_message: Seeing the wider world, and its kindness and cruelty, enriches a life, but a traveler cannot fix every place she visits.
